correctness.rationale: Verified construction line by line: X=P(E) smooth projective ruled surface via unipotent SL2 representation and Riemann-Hilbert; transversality gives T_F=pi^*T_B hence K_F=pi^*K_B nef with K_F^2=0 and K_F.C=(2g-2)deg(pi|_C)>=0 so nu=1; Sing empty hence reduced and vacuously hyperbolic; D smooth invariant section with empty intersection so generalized-curve log residues and defect 0; generic leaves are infinite Z-covers of B hence noncompact so no rational first integral; no other invariant curve by finite-orbit analysis of translations and leaf-closure argument; fibrewise discreteness plus properness gives closure L union D proper subset so both horns (A) and (B) fail. No gap in boundary conditions or computations.

originality.rationale: Fused base search plus terminal Perplexity check (20 results, 1 overlap) found no prior stating the bespoke leaf-density dichotomy with log Baum-Bott defect or its negation. All mandatory escalations sharing suspension/Riccati/translation parameters were opened to body level: classification theorems place the example in Riccati class without deciding the dichotomy; the closest genus-2 T(z)=z+1 suspension example proves leaf topology (two ends, Jacob ladder) not density/defect failure. Hence the disproof is substantively new, not a recomputation or corollary of a stronger fact.

value.rationale: TARGET disproof is a complete two-sided resolution that changes the proposed boundary: it shows nef nu=1 plus no first integral plus hyperbolic plus generalized-curve defect 0 does not force an extra invariant curve or dense leaves, with obstruction D in leaf closures. Object (P(E) over genus>=2, parabolic Riccati, infinity section) and invariant (leaf closures L union D, K_F=pi^*K_B) are natural, motivated before computation, not mechanically implied, and future work on foliation dynamics/minimal sets will need the precise fact. This is not a type error, vacuity, tiny-instance mismatch, lookup, or arbitrary parameter fact: regular case is a legitimate member of the stated hypotheses and the family is infinite. No ADMISSION_DEFECT.
